title: 安田記念の後に・強く鋭く

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr takes the win! Yamanin Zephyr pushes past a lineup of formidable foes to conquer the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you. But I can't dance atop this auspicious updraft forever.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's begin preparations for the next stage—the race to decide the fastest gust of all.
choice_data_list: Right. Next up: the Sprinters Stakes!
Right. Next up: the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. We shall blow as a razor-sharp flurry.
